# ad_delegation (Resource)

`ad_delegation` manages a single access control entry (ACE) on a directory object, i.e. it delegates a set of rights over an object (typically an OU) to a security principal. This is the equivalent of the "Delegate Control" wizard in Active Directory Users and Computers.

Each instance manages exactly one ACE, identified by the target object, the trustee, the access type, the object/inherited-object type GUIDs and the inheritance type. The rights themselves are the payload of the ACE. Because every identifying attribute forces a new resource, changing any of them (or the rights) replaces the ACE.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ad_ou" "sales" {
  name = "Sales"
  path = "DC=example,DC=com"
}

resource "ad_group" "helpdesk" {
  name             = "Helpdesk"
  sam_account_name = "helpdesk"
  container        = "CN=Users,DC=example,DC=com"
  scope            = "global"
  category         = "security"
}

# Give the Helpdesk group full control over the Sales OU and everything below it.
resource "ad_delegation" "helpdesk_full_control" {
  target_dn        = ad_ou.sales.dn
  trustee          = ad_group.helpdesk.sid
  rights           = ["GenericAll"]
  inheritance_type = "All"
}

# Delegate the "Reset Password" extended right on descendant user objects only.
# The GUIDs identify the extended right and the user schema class respectively.
resource "ad_delegation" "helpdesk_reset_password" {
  target_dn             = ad_ou.sales.dn
  trustee               = ad_group.helpdesk.sid
  rights                = ["ExtendedRight"]
  object_type           = "00299570-246d-11d0-a768-00aa006e0529" # Reset Password
  inherited_object_type = "bf967aba-0de6-11d0-a285-00aa003049e2" # user class
  inheritance_type      = "Descendents"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rights` (Set of String) The set of Active Directory rights granted or denied by this ACE (e.g. `GenericAll`, `ReadProperty`, `WriteProperty`, `CreateChild`, `ExtendedRight`). Valid values match `System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectoryRights`: `AccessSystemSecurity`, `CreateChild`, `Delete`, `DeleteChild`, `DeleteTree`, `ExtendedRight`, `GenericAll`, `GenericExecute`, `GenericRead`, `GenericWrite`, `ListChildren`, `ListObject`, `ReadControl`, `ReadProperty`, `Self`, `Synchronize`, `WriteDacl`, `WriteOwner`, `WriteProperty`.
- `target_dn` (String) The distinguished name of the object the ACE is applied to (e.g. an OU).
- `trustee` (String) The security principal receiving the rights. Accepts a SID (`S-1-5-...`) or an account name (`DOMAIN\name`), which is resolved to a SID.

### Optional

- `access_type` (String) Whether the ACE allows or denies the rights. One of `Allow` or `Deny`. Defaults to `Allow`.
- `inheritance_type` (String) How the ACE is inherited by child objects. One of `None`, `All`, `Descendents`, `SelfAndChildren` or `Children`. Defaults to `All`.
- `inherited_object_type` (String) The schema GUID of the child object class the ACE is limited to when inherited. Defaults to the all-zero GUID (no restriction).
- `object_type` (String) The schema GUID of the property, property set, extended right or child class the ACE applies to. Defaults to the all-zero GUID, meaning the ACE applies to the object as a whole.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `trustee_sid` (String) The resolved SID of the trustee.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The ID for this resource is a composite of, in order, the trustee SID, the access type,
# the object type GUID, the inherited object type GUID, the inheritance type and finally
# the target object's distinguished name, all separated by forward slashes:
# <trustee_sid>/<access_type>/<object_type>/<inherited_object_type>/<inheritance_type>/<target_dn>
$ terraform import ad_delegation.example 'S-1-5-21-1004336348-1177238915-682003330-512/Allow/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/All/OU=Sales,DC=example,DC=com'
```
